informationHealth.rule: Extend the existing Calidad owner; do not create a parallel quality application or spreadsheet-as-source-of-truth.
informationHealth.currentScope: Existing owner covers client completeness/country/currency/contact with source and audit.
targetScope: Pólizas: renewability, policy master/child lifecycle, missing contractual fields and authoritative source gaps.
Primas/Recibos: ambiguous calendars, material premium mismatches, missing frequency/installment authority, deterministic corrections pending readback.
Cancelaciones: missing reason/date and unresolved policy/detail identity.
Drive: missing/ambiguous client or insurer expediente binding.
informationHealth.paulaQueueRule: Only residual issues that require human/source input are shown as Paula actions. Deterministic/system-fix issues remain visible for transparency but are not assigned to Paula.
userExperience: KPIs by open/resolved/waiting source and domain.
Filters by domain, country, insurer, severity, owner and status.
Direct link to the exact client/policy/insurer/cancellation record.
No need for Paula to search a spreadsheet or remember a policy number.
Resolved items stay auditable; they do not disappear from history.
informationHealth.spreadsheetRole: The 81-case workbook is an export/handoff convenience only, never the canonical queue.

insurerKnowledge.rule: Insurer knowledge is captured once with source/version/validity and reused by insurer profile, policy validation, quoting, comparison, renewals and future product logic.
insurerKnowledge.noDuplication: Do not create a second insurer master, second tariff store or module-local tariff tables.
insurerKnowledge.quotingGate: A document being stored or parsed never enables automatic quoting. Only a validated, versioned, sourced rule/binding can be enabled.

businessHeuristicsPendingSource.rule: These are useful business priors supplied by Paula and historical project evidence. They guide source review but are NOT universal executable tariff rules until insurer/product evidence validates them.

Guatemala.statement: Gastos de emisión suelen ser aproximadamente 5% sobre prima neta.
Guatemala.exceptions: Columna is reported by Paula as currently not charging this item; other insurer/product exceptions may exist.

Guatemala.statement: Fraccionamiento normalmente incrementa el recargo según plazo/número de pagos; Paula reports a usual progression of roughly 1 percentage point by fractional term and about 13% at 12 payments.
Guatemala.historicalConflict: July project decision recorded observed 12-month values around 13.3%–13.6%. Therefore 13%, 13.3% and 13.6% are evidence of insurer/product variation, not a universal constant.

Colombia.statement: No insurer installment surcharge by default. Policies are usually issued as cash/contado by insurer; financing, when used, is commonly external through finance companies.
Colombia.exceptions: Insurer surcharge is allowed only when explicit source proves an exception.

Colombia.statement: Issuance/emission expenses depend on insurer/product; no universal automatic default.

order: Current official insurer tariff/cotizador/contractual document with identifiable version/validity.
Issued policy/certificate/endoso or official insurer quote that demonstrates actual components for the product/period.
Official insurer communication/manual with effective date.
Versioned tenant manual adjustment linked to a source and reason.
Business heuristic/prior for review only; never silent auto-calculation.
sourceAuthority.reconciliationRule: A proposed tariff rule must be reconciled against at least one real official output/policy when feasible. Material mismatch remains requires-validation.
sourceAuthority.supersessionRule: New sources create new versions. Prior rules remain historical and auditable; they are not silently overwritten.
sourceAuthority.storageRule: Operational Firestore stores normalized knowledge metadata/rules/status. Original documents remain documentary evidence in Drive/Library/reference provider, avoiding unnecessary binary duplication.

insurersWithMappedHistoricalSources: Aseguradora Guatemalteca: tarifario/cotizador and official vehicle quote examples.
BAM: health and vehicle Excel cotizadores.
Aseguradora Rural/Banrural: vehicle and individual medical-expense cotizadores.
Seguros Universales: official Risk Plus quotation example.
knownPriorSourceInventory.rule: Check whether prior physical source remains available before requesting re-upload from Paula.

ingestionFastTrack.objective: Recover/reuse prior work and close tariff authority with minimal delay to production.

order.action: Inventory existing Project/Library/GitHub source references and mark each as AVAILABLE / REFERENCE_ONLY / MISSING / OUTDATED.
Use available sources to extract insurer-country-product-frequency components, formula semantics, exceptions and validity; propose versioned rules and reconcile with real quote/policy examples.
Request only missing evidence in small insurer packets, starting with highest-value/exception-defining cases.
After human validation, persist normalized insurer knowledge so it is visible in insurer profile and reusable by Cotizador/Comparativo/Pólizas; no duplicate local configuration.
Generate/refresh Salud de la información residual queue. Only unresolved source-dependent records become Paula actions.

firstSourcePacketIfMissing: Guatemala: one current official AseGuate tariff/cotizador plus one real official quote or issued policy demonstrating payment components.
Guatemala exception anchor: one current Columna vehicle cotizador/quote/policy demonstrating whether issuance expense is zero and its installment behavior.
Colombia: one current insurer policy/quote with issuance expense/payment mode to anchor the no-default-surcharge model.
ingestionFastTrack.fileGuidance: Prefer original Excel/PDF. Do not manually transcribe tables. Redaction is optional if Paula prefers; source identity, insurer, product, version/date, premium components and payment plan must remain readable.

productionStrategy.rule: Do not make completion of every insurer tariff library a prerequisite for go-live.
mustCloseBeforeGoLive: Prevent silent generic premium/recargo defaults from creating unsupported totals.
Keep missing tariff authority fail-closed and visible in Salud de la información.
Preserve authoritative totals/components for existing policies.
Complete current B4-003 blocking functional regressions and exact Preview acceptance.
canContinueAfterProductionAccepted: Resolve nonblocking historical data-quality items with source.
Add additional insurer calculators/examples and superseding versions.

manualActionPolicy.allowedNow: Paula may upload requested insurer source documents when asked; this is source contribution, not manual reconciliation.
manualActionPolicy.triggerForCaseWork: Only explicit MANUAL_ACTION_START plus a residual Health-of-Information queue/list after system source exhaustion.
